input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data-return obligation in Section 4(c)
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit provision so that, on termination, we can obtain reasonable transition assistance (up to six months at Kubient's then-current rates) and a copy of our data in a machine-readable format before it is deleted. As drafted, Section 4(c)(iv) lets Kubient simply destroy our information, which leaves us unable to migrate; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if six months is difficult.

ops.text: (v) at Customer's request, Kubient shall (A) provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following termination or expiration at Kubient's then-current rates; (B) within thirty (30) days of such request, return or deliver to Customer, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, all Content, Requests and other data of, or relating to, Customer or its Properties in Kubient's possession or control ("Customer Data"); and (C) thereafter delete such Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing. Kubient's obligations under this paragraph 4(c)(v) shall take precedence over paragraph 4(c)(iv) with respect to Customer Data.
